subject: Order Form — Security exhibit & evidence sequencing
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@nimblecare.com>, Procurement <procurement@nimblecare.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Order Form — Security exhibit & evidence sequencing

Hi Marta / NimbleCare procurement team,

Thanks for the productive call last week. Attached is our latest redline package: a redlined MSA and the proposed order form for the pilot environment. Key items we still need to align on before we can push the final order form to legal: 

- Audit rights / security exhibit: we proposed scoped inspection language (SOC 2 + periodic pen test). Please confirm that NimbleCare is comfortable with a bounded inspection window rather than full tenant access.
- Evidence cadence: we usually provide SOC 2 Type II, pen test summary, and a short evidence packet on a quarterly cadence for customers who require it. If you need something different (monthly, additional artifacts) let us know.
- Pen test window: we requested a 5-business-day notice and an agreed staging window. If you have preferred weeks in Q3, share dates and we can reserve staging.

Attachments: redlined_MSA_v3.docx, orderform_NIMBLE_202705.docx.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm acceptance of the bounded inspection approach (or propose alternate language)
2) Procurement confirms DocuSign contact and PO cadence
3) We loop in our security/compliance (cc’d) to share SOC 2 and pen-test scope documents

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if it speeds closure.

Thanks,
Sergio
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@nimblecare.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>, Procurement <procurement@nimblecare.com>
Cc: James Li <james.li@nimblecare.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form — Security exhibit & evidence sequencing

Sergio — thanks for the packet. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- Bounded inspection: sounds reasonable but we need explicit assurance on data minimization during any live inspection. Can your team confirm the scope will exclude production customer data and only include sample logs/configs from staging?
- Evidence cadence: quarterly is our baseline. For the pilot we might request a one-off monthly evidence snapshot for the first two months.
- Pen test window: Security (James) prefers weeks starting 8/9 or 8/23 for Q3. Can you hold both options?

James, can you add anything on the technical asks?

Best,
Marta
Head of Procurement | NimbleCare
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@nimblecare.com>, Procurement <procurement@nimblecare.com>, James Li <james.li@nimblecare.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form — Security exhibit & evidence sequencing

Thanks Sergio / Marta — looping in legal/security to propose clear, limited language. High-level guidance from legal below (I'll add tracked changes to the redline doc):

- Bounded inspection: we can accept a staging-only inspection with explicit carveouts for production data; propose clause: “inspection limited to staging/non-production systems, sampled artifacts, and documented evidence; no production customer data shall be accessed.” I will add this as a suggested exhibit clause.
- Evidence cadence: we can commit to quarterly evidence delivery with a pilot exception for two monthly snapshots. We'll add that as a schedule in the exhibit (Attachment A).
- Pen test: technical team to confirm the staging access model and whether NimbleCare requires remote-only testing or an on-site resource. If remote, we need to formalize a 5-business-day notice and a mutual blackout calendar.

Karthik / Rishi — next actions for you: 
1) Rishi: please share the SOC 2 Type II link and a redacted pen test summary for NimbleCare to review.
2) Karthik: can you confirm whether our staging environment contains sanitized sample data suitable for their inspection? If not, what remediation is required and a rough timeline.

I will prepare tracked-change language for the MSA exhibit and the order form. Sergio, please confirm if we should route the final package via DocuSign once redlines are accepted.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@nimblecare.com>, James Li <james.li@nimblecare.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form — Security exhibit & evidence sequencing

Laura / team — sharing the items requested: 

Attachments (referenced): SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf (public SOC 2 report; redacted for distribution), pen_test_scope.xlsx (draft scope and test boundaries), pen_test_summary_redacted.pdf (summary of last third-party test). All documents are redacted to remove customer-identifying data.

On staging/data: Karthik — staging contains synthetic/sample datasets for most customers. There are two models of staging access we support: 
- Tenant-scoped staging (recommended): we create a tenant slice with synthetic data for NimbleCare and grant scoped access for inspection. This requires ~3 weeks of ops time to provision and validate.
- Shared staging with sampling: we can provide sampled artifacts (logs, config snapshots, sanitized DB exports) within 5 business days, but without interactive access.

For NimbleCare’s proposed weeks (8/9 or 8/23): both look feasible today; to lock calendar we need confirmation by 6/30.

If NimbleCare needs an on-site witness or broader access, we’ll need to escalate to infra and schedule a longer window.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@nimblecare.com>, Procurement <procurement@nimblecare.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 16:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form — Security exhibit & evidence sequencing

Marta — great, thanks for the confirmation. Recap and next steps: 

- Inspection scope: Redwood legal will add the staging-only inspection clause (Laura will send tracked changes).
- Evidence cadence: Redwood agrees to quarterly delivery; we’ll include two monthly snapshots for the pilot.
- Pen test window: holding weeks starting 8/9 and 8/23 for NimbleCare. Please confirm final date by 6/30 so Rishi can reserve the window.
- Staging access: NimbleCare prefers interactive tenant-scoped staging. Karthik, Rishi: please advise on the 3-week provisioning estimate and any blockers.
- Procurement: once we finalize redlines, I will send a DocuSign package and the HubSpot deal will be updated (link below).

DocuSign (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/ABC123-example
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deals/NDL-2027-089
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3Cexample (shared evidence folder)

If we don’t hear confirmation on dates by 6/30 I’ll assume the 8/9 window and proceed to reserve it.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the tracked-change redline once Laura posts it.

Best regards,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
